story_info.title: Penny Penguin's Veggie Faces
story_info.subtitle: Making vegetables fun to eat!
story_info.moral: Eating healthy vegetables can be fun and makes us strong.

main_character.name: Penny Penguin
main_character.appearance: Penny is a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet. She has rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance.

supporting_characters.name: Rosie Rabbit
supporting_characters.appearance: A small fluffy white rabbit with long pink ears and a tiny twitching nose.
supporting_characters.role: Finds vegetables a bit tricky to eat and needs Penny's help.

cover.prompt: Penny Penguin, a small round penguin with glossy black-and-white feathers, a bright orange beak, and orange webbed feet, with rosy cheeks and a cheerful, energetic stance, and Rosie Rabbit, a small fluffy white rabbit with long pink ears and a tiny twitching nose, are happily making faces out of colorful vegetables on a picnic blanket in Blossom Meadow. cover.visual_action: Penny and Rosie making funny faces with vegetables

slides.title: A Sunny Picnic
slides.text: Penny Penguin was at Blossom Meadow. The sun was warm and bright. She had a big basket. It was full of healthy snacks. Penny smiled a big smile. "Time for a yummy picnic!" she said happily. She saw Rosie Rabbit nearby. Rosie looked a little sad. She sat under a flower.

slides.title: Rosie's Veggie Worries
slides.text: "Hello, Rosie!" Penny called out. "Come join my picnic!" Rosie hopped closer slowly. Penny opened her basket. Inside were bright red tomatoes. There were green peas too. And long, crunchy carrots. "Yum, veggies!" said Penny. Rosie sighed a tiny sigh. "I don't like some veggies," she said.

slides.title: A Clever Idea!
slides.text: Penny had a clever idea. "Let's make it fun!" she chirped. "We can make happy faces. We use our yummy vegetables!" Rosie looked up. Her long ears twitched a little. "Happy faces with food?" she asked softly. "Yes!" Penny cheered. "It's a fun game to play!"

slides.title: Making Veggie Faces
slides.text: Penny showed Rosie how. She put two pea eyes. A carrot nose. A tomato slice smile. "See? A happy veggie face!" Rosie giggled. She picked up a small carrot. She made a funny mouth on her plate. Then she nibbled the carrot. "It's yummy!" Rosie said. "And fun!"

slides.title: Strong and Happy
slides.text: Rosie ate all her vegetables. She felt strong and full. Her tummy was happy too. "Healthy habits make every day fun!" Penny said. Rosie nodded her head. "Yes, they do!" she agreed with a smile. They finished their healthy picnic. Both friends felt happy and strong.
